description: Swift conformance workspace (docs/languages.md): a SwiftPM package. Swift has no per-file imports, so the callers in Sources/Shop read Pricing.swift through the module index. The peer changes are another agent's edits to Sources/Shop/Pricing.swift; their reads/writes are exactly what @weft/analyzer's Swift backend derives from `after` (checked by packages/conformance/test/languages.test.ts).
